title: Brain Squeeze (Naked Audio)
description: I love having an obedient toy who will let me experiment with all sorts of new and wonderful things. Especially ones I can use on someone else. On a boy who's open minded, and eager to see all the different ways in which I can work my hypnotic magic. On a good boy, like you... You don't mind letting me explore you a little do you? To be my little test bunny? You see I just found this new toy. A latex toy. Its especially designed for hypnotists to use on their toys. A toy that will allow me to control your mind with more than just words. But its a little different from what you might be used to... Let me guide you through a brand new experience. Let yourself relax, as my voice guides your thoughts and paints pictures in your mind.
author: Mistress Shibby
